tasks.label: Docker: levantar API en modo depuración
tasks.command: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.debug.yml up -d --build api

tasks.label: API: lint (ruff)
tasks.command: docker compose exec api ruff check .

tasks.label: API: aplicar migraciones
tasks.command: docker compose exec api alembic upgrade head

tasks.label: API: nueva migración
tasks.command: docker compose exec api alembic revision --autogenerate -m "${input:mensajeMigracion}"

tasks.label: Frontend: lint (oxlint)
tasks.command: docker compose exec frontend npm run lint

tasks.label: Frontend: pruebas (vitest)
tasks.command: docker compose exec frontend npm test

tasks.label: E2E: pruebas (Playwright)
tasks.command: docker compose exec api python -m app.scripts.sembrar_e2e && docker compose --profile e2e run --rm e2e

inputs.description: Descripción de la migración (p. ej. crear lote)
